AutoWidth enum

The $width argument value that means "size this to the terminal".

Cases: Auto

Banner final class

Render a bordered title banner. The title is rendered with the theme's accent style; the optional subtitle picks up the muted style. Borders default to Border::rounded() but can be overridden by passing a custom Border instance.

Frame final class

Full-screen application chrome: a double-line box that fills the terminal exactly, with a centred title bar, top/bottom dividers, and a status bar.

MethodSummary
static new(): selfDefault root — a slate box border (rgb 100,116,139 = #64748b).
withTitle(string $title): selfThe (pre-rendered) title-bar string, centred on the top row.
withTitleText(string $text, Style $style): selfTheme-aware title rendering — applies $style to $text and sets the result as the title bar. This is a convenience over withTitle() for callers that already have a Style rather than a pre-rendered string.
withStatus(string $status): selfThe (pre-rendered) status-bar string, left-aligned on the bottom row.
withBorderStyle(Style $style): selfOverride the box-drawing border colour (defaults to slate).
withTheme(?Theme $theme = null): selfAdopt the theme's muted style for the border.
withPlainBorder(): selfDrop the border styling entirely (identity Style::new()).
render(string $body, int $cols, int $rows): stringRender the framed body at exactly $cols × $rows cells.

Section final class

Render a section header — a label sandwiched between two horizontal rules: ── LABEL ──────────────. Common in CLI output where you want to break long stretches of stdout into named groups.

static rule(?Theme $theme = null, int|AutoWidth|null $width = AutoWidth::Auto, string $rune = '─'): stringRender a horizontal rule — the fill of header('') without its lead/label logic. Pass width: null for a fixed 2-cell dash. The rule is styled with the theme's muted style and accepts a custom fill rune (measured in cells for multi-cell glyphs).

Stage final class

Render a numbered "stage" line — an arrow / marker glyph + step number + message. Designed for build-script style output where each major action gets its own line:

StatusLine final class

Render a single styled "status line" — a glyph + space + message. Shaped after the success / error / warn / info lines common in Go CLI tooling so the four severities (plus the prompt) all look consistent within one program.

Theme final class

Per-status palette for the presenters that take one — StatusLine, Banner, Section, Stage and HelpText (every one of them falls back to detect() when handed no theme, per below). Themes are immutable; ansi() ships the default colourful palette, plain() produces a no-op palette ideal for snapshot tests, and the named presets in PRESET_NAMES (charm, dracula, nord, catppuccin, plus auto) cover the most-requested branded palettes.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly Style $success, public readonly Style $error, public readonly Style $warn, public readonly Style $info, public readonly Style $prompt, public readonly Style $accent, public readonly Style $muted)All seven slots are non-nullable: a theme without a style for a level is an illegal state, so the type system enforces it at the boundary (strict_types turns a null argument into a TypeError) instead of a hand-rolled constructor loop.
static ansi(): self
static detect(?array $env = null, mixed $stream = null): selfThe ansi() palette downgraded to the colour capability of the output stream — the fallback every presenter uses when no theme is passed.
withColorProfile(ColorProfile $profile): selfDowngrade every style in this theme to $profile.
static plain(): self
static auto(?BackgroundColorMsg $bg = null): selfTerminal-adaptive factory — picks a dark or light theme by checking the terminal background colour.
static build(): ThemeBuilderBegin building a custom theme with a fluent interface.
static charm(): selfCharm-brand pink + cyan accent set.
static dracula(): selfDracula palette — hex literals re-sourced from sugar-core's Palettes::DRACULA single-source-of-truth so they no longer drift as they are hand-copied around the monorepo.
static nord(): selfNord palette — cool blues and frost tones.
static catppuccin(): selfCatppuccin Mocha — pastel set.
static byName(string $name): selfResolve a theme by name. Presets: 'ansi', 'plain', 'charm', 'dracula', 'nord', 'catppuccin', and 'auto' (the adaptive factory with no background msg — the ansi() fallback). Case-insensitive.
static detectFor(mixed $stream): selfDetect for one named stream — the entry point for callers that already know their destination (a file handle, a pty master) and want the detect() downgrade without going through the default-stream substitution.
